title: Linda Brown's 2014 review of Tim Taylor's Launch Fever

tellings.quote: Taylor wrote an autobiography in March of 2003 called Launch Fever. Before anybody knew who Taylor was in 2014, Townsend Brown's daughter, Linda, wrote a review of Taylor's book.
Brown's daughter Linda reviewed Tim Taylor's book on Amazon before anybody knew who Tim Taylor was,
tellings.difference: Names Amazon as the platform and dates it only as before 2019, not to 2014.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Townsend Brown's daughter Linda reviewing Taylor's book before he was publicly known.

as_told.title: Linda Brown reviewed Tim Taylor's book

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels tells this story about Townsend Brown, a scientist he describes as building flying-saucer-like devices for the government long ago. Michels says a man named Tim Taylor wrote an autobiography, Launch Fever, in 2003, and that Brown's daughter Linda wrote a review of it, in 2014 by one account and on Amazon, before anyone knew who Taylor was. He tells it as a sign of a hidden link between Taylor and the Brown family.
